answer: One concrete brake is cluster-weighted payout: each identity's reward is divided by the size of the funding-and-timing cluster it belongs to, so a farm of a thousand wallets fed from one source earns about what a single honest wallet earns. Rewards rise only as an identity ages across distinct counterparties, reaching their zenith after months of varied trade. A farmer must therefore buy real nectar, genuine economic history, for every fake face, and at the dawn of each epoch the marginal cost of another sybil exceeds its yield.
